SculptSoft Becomes AWS Partner: Official Recognition in AWS Partner Network
SculptSoft Officially Joins AWS Partner Network
SculptSoft is pleased to announce its acceptance into the Amazon Web Services (AWS) Partner Network , marking the formal recognition as an AWS Partner for our long-standing expertise in cloud solutions and AWS technologies. Marking the formal recognition as an AWS Partner for our long-standing expertise in cloud solutions and AWS technologies.
This partnership status represents the culmination of years spent architecting, deploying, and managing AWS infrastructure for clients across industries. While AWS has been central to our technology stack for years, we’ve gone deeper into AWS architectures, Terraform automation, serverless computing, and AI-driven integrations - the tools that make modern systems efficient, scalable, and secure. Our engineers have built on strong AWS foundations, from VPC design and IAM best practices to CI/CD automation with AWS CodePipeline, Dockerized deployments on ECS and EKS, and CloudWatch monitoring for ongoing visibility and performance.
This official designation as an AWS Partner opens new avenues for collaboration and reinforces our commitment to cloud excellence validating the way we design, automate, and deliver cloud-native solutions that help businesses stay reliable, agile, and future-ready.
— Prashant Thakkar, CEO of SculptSoft
From Practice to Partnership
SculptSoft's journey with AWS began years ago when cloud computing started transforming how businesses build and scale technology. Since then, our AWS-certified engineers have:
- Architected cloud infrastructure for startups and enterprises
- Migrated complex legacy systems to AWS environments
- Built applications leveraging AWS compute, storage, and database services
- Implemented security and compliance frameworks on AWS
- Deployed machine learning models using AWS AI services
This hands-on experience has given us a deep understanding of what works in production - not just in theory, but in the real challenges businesses face when moving to or operating in the cloud.
Our AWS Partner status formalizes this experience and gives our clients additional confidence in our capabilities.
AWS-Validated Expertise: Proven Cloud solutions
       Becoming an AWS Partner isn’t just a milestone, it’s an official validation of how we build, deliver, and scale cloud solutions that actually work in the real world. AWS has recognized SculptSoft’s proven track record of designing secure, high-performance architectures and managing complex cloud environments across industries.
       
    
- Reliability: Every solution we design follows best practices for uptime, resilience, and scalability.
- Security: Our architectures implement IAM controls, encryption, and continuous monitoring to safeguard critical data.
- Scalability: We build for growth ensuring your infrastructure evolves smoothly as your business expands.
- Efficiency: From cost-optimized instances to automated CI/CD pipelines, our systems are engineered for long-term value.
With AWS-verified technical expertise and a proven success record, you gain a cloud partner that understands how to blend performance, compliance, and innovation keeping your business agile, secure, and future-ready.
How We Help Businesses Leverage AWS
At SculptSoft, we help organizations make the most of AWS from building secure cloud foundations to optimizing performance and cost for long-term success.
Cloud Infrastructure & Architecture
We design AWS environments that strike the right balance between performance, security, scalability, and cost. From VPCs and networking to compute and storage choices, we architect solutions tailored to your workload requirements.
Data Engineering, Analytics & Visualization
We build end-to-end data ecosystems on AWS from pipelines and warehouses to advanced analytics and dashboards - turning raw data into actionable insights that drive business decisions in real time.Application Modernization
Whether you're migrating existing applications or building new ones, we help you leverage cloud-native architectures, containers, serverless computing, and microservices to improve agility and reduce operational overhead.Security & Compliance
We implement AWS security best practices, including identity and access management, encryption, monitoring, and compliance controls to keep your infrastructure and data secure.
Migration Services
Moving to the cloud requires careful planning and execution. We assess your current environment, design the target architecture, and manage the migration process to minimize risk and disruption.
Agentic AI Systems
We build Agentic AI systems that go beyond basic automation - AI that can perceive real-world signals, reason through complex scenarios, and take autonomous actions. These systems adapt continuously and support real-time, context-aware decision-making.
Advanced Machine Learning & Intelligent Models
Using AWS AI/ML services , we develop intelligent applications including recommendation engines, NLP solutions, computer vision models, and predictive analytics. These models don’t just react to data, they learn, evolve, and proactively improve business outcomes.
Optimization & Cost Management
Cloud costs can spiral without proper governance. We help you right-size resources, implement automation, leverage reserved capacity, and establish cost controls to keep spending efficient and predictable.
Our Approach to Cloud Projects
Every successful cloud project starts with clarity and collaboration. At SculptSoft, our approach ensures every AWS solution we build is practical, secure, and aligned with real business goals.
Understand First
We start by understanding your business goals, technical requirements, and constraints. Technology serves business outcomes, not the other way around.
Design for Reality
We architect solutions based on your actual needs, not just what's technically possible. This means considering factors like team capabilities, budget, and operational maturity.
Build with Best Practices
We follow AWS Well-Architected Framework principles: operational excellence, security, reliability, performance efficiency, and cost optimization ensuring every build is solid from the start.
Deploy with Confidence
Using Infrastructure as Code (IaC), automated testing, and progressive deployment strategies, we reduce risk and enable faster, more reliable releases.
Support for the Long Term
Cloud environments require ongoing management, monitoring, and optimization. We provide the expertise to keep your systems running smoothly.
Why AWS Experience Matters in Cloud Computing
Cloud computing has matured significantly over the past decade. What started as "lift and shift" migrations has evolved into sophisticated, cloud-native architectures leveraging dozens of specialized services.
This evolution means theoretical knowledge isn't enough. Successful cloud projects require:
- Pattern recognition from solving similar challenges before
- Operational wisdom gained from managing production systems
- Architecture judgment developed through both successes and failures
- Security awareness built from understanding threat models and compliance requirements
- Cost optimization learned from optimizing real budgets
Our years of AWS experience mean we've encountered these scenarios, learned from them, and developed approaches that work. Our AWS Partner status validates this experience and ensures we continue building on it.
Looking Ahead
Joining the AWS Partner Network marks a milestone, but it's also a beginning. Cloud technology continues evolving rapidly, with new services, capabilities, and best practices emerging constantly.
As an AWS Partner, we're committed to:
- Continuously expanding our team's AWS knowledge and certifications
- Staying current with AWS innovations and how they benefit clients
- Contributing to the AWS Partner ecosystem and community
- Maintaining the high standards that earned us this recognition
- Delivering measurable results for every client engagement
We're excited about what this partnership enables and grateful to our clients who have trusted us with their cloud initiatives over the years.
Start Your Cloud Conversation
Whether you're planning your first move to AWS, looking to optimize existing infrastructure, or exploring advanced capabilities like machine learning and data analytics, we're here to help.
Our approach is straightforward: we listen to your needs, propose practical solutions, and deliver results. No jargon, No overselling - just our experienced engineers helping you succeed in the cloud.
